1.text: Yakobo akomeza urugendo, agera mu gihugu cy'abanyaburasirazuba.

2.text: Abona iriba riri mu gasozi, ririho imikumbi y'intama itatu ziryamye, kuko kuri iryo riba buhiriraga imikumbi kandi igitare kigomeye amazi cyari kinini.

3.text: Aho ni ho imikumbi yose yateraniraga, bagatembagaza cya gitare, bakagikura ku munwa w'iriba, bakuhira intama, bakagisubiza ku munwa w'iriba aho gihora.

4.text: Yakobo abaza abungeri ati “Bene data murava he?”Baramusubiza bati “Turi Abanyaharani.”

5.text: Arababaza ati “Muzi Labani mwene Nahori?”Baramusubiza bati “Turamuzi.”

6.text: Arababaza ati “Araho?”Baramusubiza bati “Araho kandi dore umukobwa we Rasheli azanye intama.”

7.text: Arababwira ati “Dore ntiburīra, igihe cy'amahindūra ntikirasohora, mwuhire intama mugende muziragire.”

8.text: Baramusubiza bati “Ntitubibasha imikumbi yose itaraterana, bagatembagaza igitare bakagikura ku munwa w'iriba, ni bwo turi bubone kuhira intama.”

9.text: Akivugana na bo Rasheli azana intama za se, kuko ari we uziragira.

10.text: Nuko Yakobo abonye Rasheli mwene Labani nyirarume, n'intama za Labani nyirarume, yegera iriba, atembagaza cya gitare, agikura ku munwa w'iriba, yuhira umukumbi wa Labani nyirarume.

12.text: Yakobo abwira Rasheli yuko ari mwene wabo wa se, ko ari mwene Rebeka, arirukanka abibwira se.

13.text: Nuko Labani yumvise inkuru ya Yakobo mwishywa we, arirukanka aramusanganira, aramuhobera aramusoma, amujyana iwe. Abwira Labani ibyabaye byose.

14.text: Labani aramubwira ati “Ni ukuri uri amaraso yanjye n'ubura bwanjye.” Abana na we ukwezi kumwe.

15.text: Labani abaza Yakobo ati “Kuko uri mwene wacu, ni cyo gituma unkorera ku busa? Urashaka ko nzaguhemba iki?”

16.text: Kandi Labani yari afite abakobwa babiri: umukuru yitwaga Leya, umuto yitwaga Rasheli.

17.text: Leya yari afite amaso atabengerana, ariko Rasheli yari mwiza wese, no mu maso ari heza.

18.text: Yakobo abenguka Rasheli asubiza Labani ati “Ndagutendera imyaka irindwi, uzanshyingire Rasheli umukobwa wawe muto.”

19.text: Labani aramusubiza ati “Kumuguha biruta kumuha undi muntu wese, gumana nanjye.”

20.text: Nuko Yakobo atendera imyaka irindwi kugira ngo ahabwe Rasheli, imuhwanira n'iminsi mike ku bw'urukundo amukunze.

21.text: Yakobo atebutsa kuri Labani ati “Nshyingira umugeni wanjye, murongore kuko ndangije iminsi yanjye.”

22.text: Labani atora abakwe baho bose, arabatekera arabagaburira.

23.text: Nimugoroba azana Leya umukobwa we aramumushyingira, aramurongora.

24.text: Labani atanga Zilupa umuja we, amuha umukobwa we Leya ho indongoranyo.

25.text: Mu gitondo Yakobo abona ari Leya. Abaza Labani ati “Wangize ibiki? Rasheli si we natendeye? Ni iki gitumye undiganya utyo?”

26.text: Labani aramusubiza ati “Iwacu ntibagenza batyo, gushyingira umuto basize umukuru.

27.text: Mara iminsi irindwi y'uwo, tubone kugushyingirira n'uriya iyindi myaka irindwi uzatenda.”

28.text: Yakobo abigenza atyo amara iminsi irindwi ya Leya, Labani amushyingira Rasheli umukobwa we.

29.text: Kandi Labani atanga Biluha umuja we, amuha Rasheli umukobwa we ho indongoranyo.

30.text: Yakobo arongora na Rasheli, akundwakaza Rasheli, anyungwakaza Leya, atenda kuri Labani indi myaka irindwi.

31.text: Uwiteka abona ko Leya anyungwakaye azibūra inda ye, ariko Rasheli yari ingumba.

32.text: Leya asama inda abyara umuhungu, amwita Rubeni ati “Ni uko Uwiteka yabonye umubabaro wanjye, noneho umugabo wanjye azankunda.”

33.text: Asama indi nda abyara umuhungu ati “Kuko Uwiteka yumvise nywungwakaye, ni cyo gitumye anyongera n'uyu.” Amwita Simiyoni.

34.text: Asama indi nda abyara umuhungu ati “Noneho ndafatana n'umugabo wanjye, kuko twabyaranye abahungu batatu.” Ni cyo cyatumye yitwa Lewi.

35.text: Asama indi nda abyara umuhungu ati “Ubu ndashima Uwiteka.” Ni cyo cyatumye amwita Yuda. Aba arekeye aho kubyara.
